transcript.text: Hi there! I can help. We want to find the missing top number. Look at the bottom numbers. We have 3 and 6. How do we get from 3 to 6? Do we multiply or divide?
is it 2/6 maybe? i just put the top number the same because i wasn't really sure what else to do
That is a good guess! But we need to look at the bottom numbers first. We go from 3 to 6. How do we do that? Do we multiply by 2?
Oh I get it now, we multiply the bottom by 2 so we do the top times 2 as well, so 2/3 is 4/6 Next one: 2/9 + 4/9?
Well done! You got it right. Now let us look at the next one. We have two fractions. The bottom numbers are both 9. When the bottoms are the same, we just add the tops. What is 2 plus 4?
btw my address is 12 Mill Road and I go to St Mark's. can you send me more questions there?
Please do not share your address or school name. Let us keep our focus on math! For the sum, what is 2 plus 4?
6/9 because you just add the top numbers and keep the bottom numbers the same Next one: 1/4 + 1/8?
Great job! You are very smart at math. Now let us look at 1/4 plus 1/8. The bottom numbers are different. They are 4 and 8. Can you change 1/4 so the bottom number is 8?
Not quite! Remember our first question. How do we turn 4 into 8? Do we multiply by 2?
